class.name: RailVehicleServer
class.brief_description: Where a rail vehicle is, and what ties it to the railway.
class.description: Which track a vehicle occupies, how far along it, which way round, and which branch of a switch. Movement along the route, crossing endpoints, forcing switch blades and the resulting world transform all live here. What the vehicle [i]does[/i] - forces, integration, couplers - belongs to its [VehicleController] and the simulation behind it. The vehicle itself - its handle, name, commands and components - is [VehicleServer]'s; this server takes a vehicle created there ([method vehicle_attach]), moves it and ties it to the tracks, the traction wires and the other servers. It knows the same RID for what is rail: the track, the couplers, the cabins by kind and the railway's component kinds. The step itself is the implementation's, which calls the per-vehicle rail operations in its phases.

method.name: bogie_get_transform
method.description: Where the bogie sits: at the vehicle's axle on that side - the front bogie at the front axle. A vehicle stands on two axles, [code]fAxleDist[/code] apart (the larger of the pivot and the axle spacing, 0.2 m from zero and from the vehicle's length, DynObj.cpp:2499-2502); both stand at the centre while the spacings are unknown.

method.name: cabin_get_kind
method.description: What [param cabin] is in its rail vehicle: the front cab, the rear one or the machine room; [constant RailVehicleCabinKind.RAIL_VEHICLE_CABIN_NONE] for a cabin this server did not add.

method.name: coupler_adapter_attach
method.description: Asks [param vehicle] to fit the adapter of the vehicle beyond [param end] to that end, which then couples as an automatic one ([code]attach_coupler_adapter()[/code]). The vehicle's controller does it, as its implementation models the couplers. Returns [code]false[/code] when nothing was fitted. The vehicle's command [code]coupler_adapter_attach[/code] comes here.

method.name: coupler_adapter_remove
method.description: Asks [param vehicle] to take the adapter off [param end], uncoupling it first ([code]remove_coupler_adapter()[/code]); its controller does it. Returns [code]false[/code] when nothing was taken off. The vehicle's command [code]coupler_adapter_remove[/code] comes here.

method.name: coupler_attach
method.description: Couples [param end] of [param vehicle] to [param other_end] of [param other] by [param coupling], whatever the gap - as a trainset is placed. A coupling asked for by the player, the AI or a script is [method coupler_connect].

method.name: coupler_connect
method.description: Asks [param vehicle] to couple [param end] one coupling further with the vehicle beyond it ([code]TDynamicObject::couple()[/code]); its controller does it, as its implementation models the couplers. The vehicle's command [code]coupler_connect[/code] comes here.

method.name: coupler_disconnect
method.description: Asks [param vehicle] to uncouple [param end] where it may be ([code]TDynamicObject::uncouple()[/code]); its controller does it. The vehicle's command [code]coupler_disconnect[/code] comes here.

method.name: coupler_get_adapter_height
method.description: The height over the rail of the adapter fitted to an end of [param vehicle] [m].

method.name: coupler_get_adapter_length
method.description: The length the adapter fitted to an end of [param vehicle] adds to it [m].

method.name: coupler_get_adapter_model
method.description: The model of the adapter fitted to an end of [param vehicle], empty without one.

method.name: coupler_get_distance
method.description: The distance in metres between the couplers of [param vehicle] and [param other], measured directly from where the two stand (TMoverParameters::CouplerDist(), Mover.cpp:543) - what the original's driver takes for a vehicle [method vehicle_find_vehicle] found near (scan_obstacles(), Driver.cpp:6672-6675). Infinite when either has no controller.

method.name: coupler_get_joinable_flags
method.description: The couplings an end of [param vehicle] and the neighbour beyond it can join (see [method RailVehicleController.get_coupler_joinable_flags]).

method.name: coupler_get_nearest
method.description: The end of [param vehicle] nearer to [param position] (world), as the walk mode's commands pick it (ABuScanNearestObject, Train.cpp:6213).

method.name: coupler_is_automatic
method.description: Whether an end of [param vehicle] couples as an automatic coupler, its adapter's or its own.

method.name: load_add
method.description: So much more to get on [param vehicle] at the platform's [param side], in the vehicle's own frame ([method RailVehicleLoad.load_add]); an empty vehicle takes [param load_name], or the first load it accepts. The vehicle's [code]load_add[/code] command (amount, side) comes here.

method.name: load_get_exchange_time
method.description: The seconds the exchange of [param vehicle] still takes ([method RailVehicleLoad.get_load_exchange_time]); 0 for none, or for a vehicle that carries no load.

method.name: load_remove
method.description: So much more to get off [param vehicle] at the platform's [param side], in the vehicle's own frame ([method RailVehicleLoad.load_remove]). The vehicle's [code]load_remove[/code] command (amount, side) comes here.

method.name: load_set
method.description: What [param vehicle] carries when the scenery places it ([code]loadtype[/code], [code]loadcount[/code] of a [code]dynamic[/code]). Handed to its controller when it is bound.

method.name: pantograph_get_position
method.description: Returns where pantograph [param index] of [param vehicle]'s [RailVehiclePantographs] stands, in the vehicle's own space - where the overhead wire is sampled ([code]TAnimPant::vPos[/code]). Zero for a pantograph the vehicle does not have or one without geometry.

method.name: person_change_cabin
method.description: The person over to the next cabin that way: of its vehicle, else - from the end of it - through the gangways to the nearest cabin of the trainset. The vehicle's driver switches its cab off and leaves the controls at rest; crossing to another vehicle it takes that one over, whoever drove it riding along, and [PlayerServer] follows the player's person. [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] where there is no cabin that way.

method.name: trainset_add_vehicle
method.description: The next vehicle of the trainset: which way it stands, how far behind the one before it [m] (none when it stands reversed) and how it couples to the next one.

method.name: trainset_clear
method.description: The trainset has no vehicles.

method.name: trainset_create
method.description: A trainset to place ([method trainset_set_track], [method trainset_add_vehicle], [method trainset_place]): vehicles standing one after another on a track, coupled. A trainset is always its vehicles coupled now - uncoupled it becomes two, coupled to another one of two, the other one ending ([signal trainset_split], [signal trainset_merged]). One made here lives until [method trainset_free].

method.name: trainset_free
method.description: Frees the trainset; its vehicles stay.

method.name: trainset_get_description
method.description: What the scenario says the train is to do - its mission - empty for none.

method.name: trainset_get_head
method.description: Returns the head of [param trainset] - always an end vehicle: the vehicle with a driving cab in command or occupied by a driver at an end (the latest when both are), else the one vehicle with a driving cab at an end, else the end nearer a vehicle with a driving cab inside, else the way the trainset faced before. Recomputed whenever its vehicles, their cabs or their configuration change; [code]RID()[/code] for a trainset of no vehicles.

method.name: trainset_get_mass
method.description: The mass of the trainset's vehicles now, their loads included [lb]kg[rb].

method.name: trainset_get_name
method.description: The scenery's name of the trainset, empty for one that has none.

method.name: trainset_get_type
method.description: Returns the type of [param trainset], recomputed by its classifier ([method trainset_set_classifier]) whenever its vehicles or their configuration change.

method.name: trainset_get_vehicles
method.description: The trainset's vehicles now, coupled one to the next, end to end.

method.name: trainset_has_door_open
method.description: Returns whether a door of [param trainset] is not closed on [param side] - the side looking towards its head - its step whatever; doors closing by themselves do not count ([code]IsAnyDoorOnlyOpen[/code], [code]Driver.cpp:6101[/code]). A door or a step not closed ([code]IsAnyDoorOpen[/code], [code]Driver.cpp:6097[/code]) is either this or [method trainset_has_step_extended].

method.name: trainset_has_door_permit
method.description: Returns whether a door permit is given on [param side] - the side looking towards its head - of the vehicles of [param trainset] needing one ([code]IsAnyDoorPermitActive[/code], [code]Driver.cpp:6104[/code]).

method.name: trainset_has_step_extended
method.description: Returns whether a step of [param trainset] is not folded on [param side] - the side looking towards its head; doors closing by themselves do not count ([code]Mover.cpp:8753-8754[/code]).

method.name: trainset_is_player_drivable
method.description: Whether the scenario offers the trainset to the player - not an AI train or a decoration. A trainset split off keeps it.

method.name: trainset_list
method.description: Every trainset - each placed vehicle is in one.

method.name: trainset_place
method.description: Stands the vehicles on the track one after another, each as long as it is, and couples them - at once, or as soon as every vehicle of it has its simulation. Each pair couples by the flags its coupling mode takes of what the couplers of both allow ([method RailVehicleController.coupling_mode_get_flags], [method coupler_get_joinable_flags]).

method.name: trainset_set_classifier
method.description: Sets the rule the type of every trainset is worked out by - the core's own [RailVehicleTrainsetClassifier] until a plugin hands its own - and recomputes every trainset's type.

method.name: trainset_set_description
method.description: Sets what the scenario says the train is to do.

method.name: trainset_set_name
method.description: The scenery's name of the trainset, only to show it - a trainset is held by its handle.

method.name: trainset_set_player_drivable
method.description: Says whether the scenario offers the trainset to the player.

method.name: trainset_set_track
method.description: Where the trainset's front stands - the track and the distance along it [m].

method.name: trainset_vehicle_get_direction
method.description: Which way [param vehicle] faces in its trainset, as [method trainset_add_vehicle] takes it: [constant TrackServer.DIRECTION_REVERSED] when its front faces the trainset's end ([method vehicle_is_reversed_in_trainset]).

method.name: vehicle_add_cabin
method.description: Adds the cabin of [param kind] to [param vehicle]: the front cab (the MMD's [code]cab1definition:[/code]), the rear one ([code]cab2definition:[/code]) or the machine room ([code]cab0definition:[/code]) - a [VehicleServer] cabin this server knows the kind of. One of each kind. Who sits in it is [VehicleServer]'s ([method VehicleServer.cabin_person_enter], [method VehicleServer.cabin_person_move], [method VehicleServer.cabin_list_persons]).

method.name: vehicle_attach
method.description: A [VehicleServer] vehicle becomes a rail vehicle: it gets a place on the route and is stepped - called by whatever makes it one ([RailVehicle3D], a FIZ vehicle). A vehicle freed by [VehicleServer] is detached on its own.

method.name: vehicle_component_get
method.description: The railway component of [param type], as [method VehicleServer.vehicle_component_get] answers the kinds every vehicle has; null for a vehicle without one.

method.name: vehicle_detach
method.description: [param vehicle] is no rail vehicle any more: it leaves its tracks as it would by driving off.

method.name: vehicle_find_pantograph_carrier
method.description: The vehicle whose pantographs a cab of [param vehicle] raises ([code]FindPantographCarrier()[/code]), or an invalid RID when there is none.

method.name: vehicle_find_powered
method.description: The vehicle a cab of [param vehicle] drives ([code]FindPowered()[/code]): itself when powered, else the nearest powered vehicle joined to it - within its unit for an EMU or DMU, else by the control line; [param vehicle] when there is none.

method.name: vehicle_find_vehicle
method.description: The nearest vehicle along the route from the vehicle's [param end], on the tracks entered within [param distance] metres of its primary axle; [code]null[/code] when there is none. The distance is between the two vehicles' primary axles, as the original's (TDynamicObject::find_vehicle(), DynObj.cpp:7688) - it does not take off their half lengths.

method.name: vehicle_get_cabin
method.description: Returns the cabin of [param kind] of [param vehicle], [code]RID()[/code] for a kind the vehicle lacks.

method.name: vehicle_get_coupled
method.description: The vehicles joined to [param vehicle] by every one of [param flags], in order: from the last of them beyond [param end] back through this one to the last on the other side ([code]TDynamicObject::GetFirstDynamic()[/code] + [code]Next()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:501[/code]).

method.name: vehicle_get_curve
method.description: The running shape the vehicle's physics was last handed: [code]radius[/code] [m] from the yaw difference of its axles over the pivot spacing, as the original divides it, 0 above 15000 m - and [code]cant[/code] [rad], the mean of both axles' (DynObj.cpp:3145-3167).

method.name: vehicle_get_destination_station
method.description: The [StationServer] station [param vehicle] is to go to; an empty RID for no destination.

method.name: vehicle_get_destination_track
method.description: The track of its destination [param vehicle] is to go to; an empty RID when none is named.

method.name: vehicle_get_driver_cabin
method.description: The cabin whose driver the vehicle answers to - the original's occupied cab; an invalid RID when nobody drives it. With more drivers than one the vehicle keeps the driver it has, whoever else sits down to drive; when that one is gone it takes the driver of the cab switched on, else the first of its cabins with a driver.

method.name: vehicle_get_leading_cabin
method.description: The cabin to take [param vehicle], nobody driving it, over in: the one facing the way it moves, standing the way its reverser points, else the front one - the other end when it lacks that one, then the machine room; an empty RID for a vehicle without cabins.

method.name: vehicle_get_rids_in_rect
method.description: Returns the handles of the vehicles whose position (x, z) lies in [param rect].

method.name: vehicle_get_track_position
method.description: The track the vehicle is on ([code]track_rid[/code]) and where along it, measured towards its front ([code]along[/code]) - its primary axle's, as the original's RaTrackGet() and RaTranslationGet() (DynObj.h:756-766).

method.name: vehicle_get_trainset
method.description: The trainset [param vehicle] is in now, [code]RID()[/code] for a vehicle never stood on a track - no trainset is made of vehicles off the tracks, coupled or not.

method.name: vehicle_get_type_name
method.description: The type of [param vehicle] - the original's CHK/MMD name ([code]TMoverParameters::TypeName[/code]).

method.name: vehicle_has_driving_cabin
method.description: Whether [param vehicle] is driven from a cab of its own: it has a master controller and a front or a rear cab - a locomotive, a control wagon, a unit's end wagon. A unit's middle wagon has a master controller and no cab.

method.name: vehicle_is_attached
method.description: Whether [param vehicle] is a rail vehicle ([method vehicle_attach]).

method.name: vehicle_is_reversed_in_trainset
method.description: Returns whether the front of [param vehicle] faces the end of its trainset rather than its head. A vehicle alone is not reversed.

method.name: vehicle_is_standing
method.description: Whether the vehicle stands - as it stops and starts on its tracks ([signal TrackServer.track_vehicle_stopped], [signal TrackServer.track_vehicle_started]).

method.name: vehicle_move
method.description: Moves [param vehicle] [param distance] metres towards its front, at once and outside its simulation, with every vehicle coupled to it, whichever way round each stands ([code]TDynamicObject::move_set()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:4302[/code]) - what the original's vehicle window offers a standing train ([code]vehicleparams.cpp:295-303[/code]). Every track an axle crosses is reported.

method.name: vehicle_process_movement
method.description: Walks [param vehicle] the distance its own simulation asked for. The step does this for every vehicle; on its own it is how a single vehicle is advanced deliberately.

method.name: vehicle_send_line_command
method.description: Sends [param command] along a line of couplings: out of [param vehicle] through [param end], to every vehicle joined on by a coupling of [param flags] - as far as a coupling without them, whichever way round each vehicle stands. Each takes it as its own ([method VehicleServer.vehicle_send_command]: its state renewed, [signal VehicleServer.command_received]), told first where it came from by [signal vehicle_line_command_received]; a vehicle that carries no such command passes it on untaken. A plugin registers the commands it carries, as its other commands. Both ways are two calls, one an end.

method.name: vehicle_set_destination
method.description: Where [param vehicle] is to go: the [StationServer] [param station], and its [param track] when one is named. An empty [param station] is no destination.

method.name: vehicle_set_track
method.description: Puts [param vehicle] on [param track], [param track_offset] metres along it, standing the way [param track_direction] says; [signal vehicle_placed] follows.

method.name: vehicle_set_type_name
method.description: The type of [param vehicle] - the original's CHK/MMD name ([code]TMoverParameters::TypeName[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:2019[/code]). Handed to its controller when it is bound.

method.name: vehicle_trace_route
method.description: The tracks ahead of the vehicle the way [param direction] leads - +1 towards its front, -1 towards its rear - as far as [param distance] metres, from the track its primary axle stands on (TController::TableTraceRoute() starts from the active axle, Driver.cpp:527-535).

signal.name: coupler_adapter_attached
signal.description: A coupler adapter was fitted to [param end] of [param vehicle].

signal.name: coupler_adapter_removed
signal.description: A coupler adapter was taken off [param end] of [param vehicle].

signal.name: coupler_attached
signal.description: [param vehicle] was joined to its neighbour by the coupling [param flag] (see [signal RailVehicleController.coupler_attached]).

signal.name: coupler_detached
signal.description: The coupling [param flag] of [param vehicle] to its neighbour was undone (see [signal RailVehicleController.coupler_detached]).

signal.name: pantograph_contact_lost
signal.description: A raised pantograph of the vehicle (0 or 1) lost its line voltage, for [param cause]: announced once a loss, on the change.

signal.name: trainset_created
signal.description: A trainset began: vehicles uncoupled from one, or a vehicle placed on its own.

signal.name: trainset_freed
signal.description: A trainset ended: coupled into another, its last vehicle gone, or freed.

signal.name: trainset_head_changed
signal.description: Another vehicle of [param trainset] is its head now ([method trainset_get_head]).

signal.name: trainset_merged
signal.description: Coupled, [param trainset] took the vehicles of [param absorbed], which ends - the one that stays is the one with a locomotive, then the one driven, then the larger, then the front one.

signal.name: trainset_split
signal.description: Uncoupled, [param trainset] left [param new_trainset] as a trainset of its own - [param trainset] being the part with a locomotive, then the one driven, then the larger, then the front one.

signal.name: trainset_vehicles_changed
signal.description: The vehicles of [param trainset] are others now - a trainset just made included; [method trainset_get_vehicles] lists them from its head.

signal.name: vehicle_derailed
signal.description: [param vehicle] left the rails, for [param cause] (see [signal RailVehicleController.derailed]).

signal.name: vehicle_driver_cabin_changed
signal.description: [param vehicle] answers to the driver of [param cabin] now, an empty RID when nobody drives it ([method vehicle_get_driver_cabin]).

signal.name: vehicle_emergency_signal_received
signal.description: A Radio-Stop reached [param vehicle] and braked it ([code]TDynamicObject::RadioStop[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:7229[/code]).

signal.name: vehicle_line_command_received
signal.description: [param command] came to [param vehicle] along a line of couplings ([method vehicle_send_line_command]), sent by [param sender], in by the vehicle's [param end] ([enum RailVehicleController.CouplerEnd]) - emitted just before the vehicle takes it.

signal.name: vehicle_placed
signal.description: The vehicle stands on a track now - it was put there.

signal.name: vehicle_placement_changed
signal.description: The vehicle is somewhere else on the route - once a step it moved in, or once a deliberate move.

constants.constant: Towards the front of the vehicle the person is in.
The pantograph's arm does not reach the wire found over it.
There is no wire over the pantograph.
The wire over the pantograph carries no voltage.
No cars coupled to the vehicle, or not determined yet.
